summary: The @gyomu/ui package serves as the primary component library and design system interface for the project. It consolidates foundational UI building blocks, declarative form generation systems, and architectural adapters for third-party libraries like Material UI. By standardizing component behaviors and layouts, it ensures visual and functional consistency across the application.
responsibilities: Provide a unified library of reusable, atomic, and composite UI components.
Define declarative interfaces for dynamic form generation based on schemas.
Implement an abstraction layer to adapt third-party libraries to project-specific design standards.
Maintain consistent layout patterns for forms and form-related fields.
Centralize configuration for styling, typography, and utility-based interface interactions.

capabilities.name: Design System Components
capabilities.description: A comprehensive suite of primitive and composite UI elements that enforce project-wide styling and interaction patterns.

capabilities.name: Declarative Form Generation
capabilities.description: An automated system that renders complete forms based on provided schemas, reducing manual boilerplate for complex data entry.

capabilities.name: Component Adaptation
capabilities.description: Standardized wrappers that integrate third-party libraries like Material UI, ensuring they conform to project-specific requirements and theme constraints.

capabilities.name: Form Layout Management
capabilities.description: Headless and styled layout components designed to structure the arrangement of form fields, labels, and error states consistently.

capabilities.name: UI Utility Integration
capabilities.description: Shared utility functions for class name composition and conditional styling that ensure consistent Tailwind CSS class merging.

designDecisions: Abstraction through adapters to maintain a stable API while supporting different underlying component frameworks (e.g., Shadcn UI and Material UI).
Headless layout design for core structure, separating semantic arrangement from specific visual presentation.
Centralized state and context providers for interactive components like tooltips and forms to simplify consumption.
Composition-first approach using atomic building blocks to construct complex user interfaces.
usageGuidance: Use the standard components from the top-level entry point for general UI needs to ensure consistency.
Prefer the AutoForm feature for complex forms where UI should be driven by data schemas rather than manual JSX construction.
Utilize the provided Mui adapters when working within existing Material UI contexts to maintain visual alignment with the design system.
Leverage the exported 'cn' utility for safe and efficient Tailwind CSS class merging when customizing component styles.
